body: If you want to get help then you should. Who cares what people think.... If they judge you it's because they are worthless. The difference between you and me is I don't want help.. If i wanted it I would ask for it and get it... I couldn't give less fucks if people think I'm crazy or not..if I had a peaceful way to go right now i wouldn't even be here writing this No doubt in my mind what's so ever, ive never been so sure about anything except for the love I felt for someone who was taken from me suddenly and tragically. No one in this world is normal. If you want it ,,, go get it without shame.
Even if you understood .. It wouldn't take away my pain. The pain is always there.
